sources.title: SinBERT-large | PromptLayer Models
sources.snippet: SinBERT-large is a sophisticated language model specifically designed for the Sinhala language, built upon the RoBERTa architecture. It represents a significant advancement in Sinhala natural language processing, having been pre-trained on a comprehensive corpus of 15 million Sinhala texts (sin-cc-15M).
